title: Twisters
about: A storm chaser who lost her team comes back to Oklahoma and teams up with a YouTube tornado wrangler to try to break up a twister.
cue: Bring out the funnel cakes when Tyler takes Kate to the rodeo in Stillwater.
faces: Tyler's crew rolls in from Arkansas. Cornmeal-crusted okra and a smoky dip.

    SmallFried okra with comeback sauceTyler's crew rolls in from Arkansas. Cornmeal-crusted okra and a smoky dip.How to make it400g fresh okra, cut in 2cm pieces250ml buttermilk100g fine cornmeal50g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika750ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp chilli sauce1 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauce1/2 lemonStir the mayonnaise, chilli sauce, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into the comeback sauce.Soak the okra in the buttermilk, then toss it in the cornmeal, flour, paprika and a big pinch of salt.Fry in batches at 180°C until crisp and golden, then drain.Salt straight away and serve hot with the sauce.El Reno fried onion burgersThe fire tornado heads for El Reno. Smashed beef, crisp onions, American cheese.How to make it500g beef mince, 20 percent fat2 brown onions, sliced paper thin8 slices of American cheese8 slider buns20g butter8 dill pickle slices2 tbsp yellow mustardRoll the beef into 8 balls and season well.Heat a heavy pan very hot, add a ball, pile on a handful of onions and smash flat through the onions with a spatula.Cook until the edges crust, flip so the onions fry underneath, and lay on a slice of cheese.Toast the buttered buns, then build with pickle and mustard and serve hot.Tornado Wrangler roasted peanutsMerch money goes to the towns that got hit.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.BigSapulpa chicken-fried steakKate goes home to her mum's farm. Crumbed steak, pepper gravy, mash and greens.How to make it4 x 150g beef minute steaks150g plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for the gravy2 eggs125ml buttermilk1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp cracked black pepper250ml vegetable oil500ml milk800g floury potatoes40g butter1 bunch silverbeet, shreddedBoil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and a splash of the milk.Season the flour with garlic powder, pepper and salt; whisk the eggs with the buttermilk.Dip the steaks in flour, egg, then flour again, pressing it on well.Shallow-fry in hot oil until deep golden, about 3 minutes a side, and drain.Pour off all but 2 tbsp of oil, whisk in 2 tbsp flour, then the rest of the milk, and simmer into a peppery gravy.Wilt the silverbeet and serve with the steak, mash and gravy.Smoked brisket rollsRiggs buys up the storm-wrecked land. Slow-smoked beef with jalapeno slaw.How to make it1.5kg beef brisket2 tbsp smoked paprika2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp garlic powder250ml beef stock250ml smoky barbecue sauce6 soft long rolls1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded1 carrot, grated2 tbsp pickled jalapenos, chopped3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp apple cider vinegarRub the brisket all over with the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and salt.Sit it in a roasting dish with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150°C until it pulls apart.Rest, then slice or shred and toss with the barbecue sauce and some of the pan juices.Mix the cabbage, carrot, jalapenos, mayo and vinegar into a slaw.Pile the brisket and slaw into the rolls.SweetRodeo funnel cakes with strawberriesTyler takes Kate to the rodeo. Fried batter swirls, icing sugar, berries.How to make it250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder2 tbsp caster sugar2 eggs330ml milk1 tsp vanilla extract1 L vegetable oil, for frying250g strawberries, sliced4 tbsp icing sugarWhisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs, milk and vanilla into a smooth pouring batter.Heat the oil to 180°C in a wide pan.Pour a cup of batter through a funnel or a squeeze bottle in a loose swirl and fry until golden, turning once.Drain, dust heavily with icing sugar and top with strawberries.SipsStorm chaser bourbon lemonadeTyler says if you feel it chase it. Bourbon, fresh lemonade and a mint sprig.How to make it180ml fresh lemon juice100g caster sugar600ml cold water160ml bourbon1 bunch mint2 cups ice cubesStir the lemon juice and sugar until dissolved, then add the water.Fill 4 jars with ice, add 40ml bourbon each, top with lemonade and a mint sprig.Iced sweet tea by the jugBrewed strong and poured over a lot of ice.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
